Message:
Ayse offered to help me learn,
but learning is no good.
That is a law.

So, I have to say no.
But, I already broke a law...

Huh...? If a law is broken,
a disaster should happen.
So, why did nothing go wrong...?

“Wanting to know something
isn’t a bad thing.

Keeping promises is important,
but letting your curiosity
be your guide
matters just as much.”

Just like how I do not know
why every day is sparkly-sparkly
now that I met Ayse.
I wonder what
that feeling is called?

I want to know...
the name of this feeling.

The reason I look forward to
every morning after meeting Ayse.

That way, you won’t have to
worry about anyone
getting mad at you, right?”

After that, I learned
the alphabet from Ayse.
Learning is very fun.

But, me and Ayse
are different in every way...
